Events and gatherings

Any kind of an event. Showers, reunions, retreats, teas, birthday and retirement parties, small concerts, and the papercrafting classes we hold in the barn ourselves.

What we host

  • Baby and wedding showers

    Round tables in the barn, the patio for the afternoon, and the field for photos.

  • Reunions and parties

    Family reunions, birthdays, retirement parties and anniversaries. Up to 135 people, with your caterer in the prep kitchen.

  • Retreats

    Women’s retreats, church groups, and company retreats. The barn for the sessions, the patio and the field for the breaks, and the Lakes Region for the evenings.

  • Small concerts

    The acoustics in the barn are good. The High Street Jazz Band played our open house. We would love a bluegrass, country or gospel group next. [CONFIRM: band name]

  • Teas and workshops

    Afternoon teas, creative workshops and classes. We have 15 seats at the tables for a class.

  • Community events

    Once a year we donate the venue for a charitable event. If you have one in mind, ask.

Cardmaking in the barn

Susan teaches papercrafting and cardmaking classes in the barn. You make five cards or items at each class, and all supplies are provided. Watch our Facebook page for dates.

Coming up

No events are scheduled right now. Follow us on Facebook, or ask about hosting your own.

Retreats for parents

Susan spent her career in special education, and she is the mother of a daughter with autism. She knows how hard the first years can be. She is planning retreats here for parents of children with disabilities: a weekend at the barn with a guest speaker, time to meet other parents, and a reason to come back each year.
